Details 
 Every cowboy needs a dependable button-down he can wear any day of the week. Luckily, the men's George Strait long-sleeve button-down two-pocket plaid shirt comes fully equipped with everything you need to make your mark. This classic plaid button-down features a relaxed fit, a pointed collar, a straight back yoke, two button-through chest pockets, adjustable cuffs, a curved hem, and the George Strait logo embroidered at the chest for a stamp of authenticity. Wear yours with one of the George Strait Cowboy Cut® jeans to complete your look for any occasion.
